item.title: When Reconciling Twice Costs Money: CRDs, Providers, and Content-Addressed Fingerprints
item.description: CRDs, the provider pattern, and a content-addressed fingerprint that decides whether an expensive model call happens at all. Learning the operator pattern by building one where getting it wrong costs money.
